observations.behavior: Changes credential validation to use probe_path instead of path, and P1.F5.H1 adds a test for probing parent paths of fanned-out schemas.
observations.code_quote: path = ASHBY_ENDPOINTS[schema_name].probe_path if schema_name is not None else DEFAULT_PROBE_PATH
observations.posthog_connection: This change allows credential checks to use the parent path for fan-out schemas, rather than the child path, which is necessary for correct access checks.
